meta.description: Use Therapeutics Data Commons through the PyTDC Python package for registry discovery, approved dataset access, task-aware splits, evaluator metrics, benchmark groups, and bounded molecular-oracle workflows. Provides comprehensive network/storage policy and bundled audit scripts.

scientific_integrity.detail: Accurate representation of PyTDC capabilities with explicit uncertainty documentation for upstream gaps

practice_boundaries.detail: Appropriate scope for therapeutic ML dataset access with clear warnings about data leakage and license verification requirements

methodological_ground.detail: Based on established ML split methods with explicit caveats against overclaiming leakage control

code_usability.detail: All 5 bundled scripts are syntactically correct with proper lazy imports and safety guards

functional_suitability.note: Comprehensive coverage of TDC workflows: registry discovery, dataset loading, splits, evaluators, benchmarks, and oracles

reliability.note: Exceptional reliability with non-negotiable data/network policy, explicit approval gates, bounded outputs, cache audit tooling

performance_context.note: Well-organized with 4 reference files, 5 bundled scripts, clear cache/cost behavior documentation

agent_usability.note: Outstanding with discover-first policy, exact workflow ordering (discover → plan → ask → execute), split caveats, evaluator registry

human_usability.note: Clear installation with CPython 3.11 pinning, setuptools compatibility fix, uv-based ephemeral commands, all scripts have --help

security.note: Excellent security: explicit --execute and --download flags, no implicit downloads, bounded outputs, safe cache paths, oracle restrictions

maintainability.note: Version 1.1, MIT license, verified snapshot with research date, known upstream gaps documented

agent_specific.note: Strong composability with allowed-tools, clear trigger (TDC/PyTDC), progressive disclosure via metadata-first; minor: fuzzy matching behavior could be more prominent

assertions.note: Rejection mechanism implied but not explicitly shown

key_strengths: Exceptional data governance with non-negotiable 5-step policy (discover → plan → ask → execute → bounded outputs) enforced via --execute and --download flags
Outstanding transparency about upstream gaps: documented ReadTheDocs version mismatch, no maintained changelog, setuptools 82 incompatibility
Excellent split methodology guidance with explicit anti-overclaiming: 'scaffold does NOT prove absence of analog, duplicate, label, temporal, or provenance leakage'
Strong security posture: lazy imports, safe cache paths, bounded outputs, oracle restrictions, no implicit downloads
Comprehensive bundled tooling with 5 scripts covering discovery, loading, evaluation, oracles, and cache auditing

recommendations.title: Emphasize fuzzy matching behavior earlier
recommendations.problem: Fuzzy matching note appears late in metadata workflow section
recommendations.root_cause: Agent-specific 'trigger precision' could be more prominent
recommendations.fix: Add note to ## Start with metadata-only discovery: 'IMPORTANT: Use exact returned names. PyTDC performs fuzzy matching internally but can select wrong dataset/oracle.'

recommendations.title: Add molecule generation framework pointers
recommendations.problem: Scope boundary (training) lacks redirect to appropriate tools
recommendations.fix: Add to ## Molecular generation and oracles: 'For de novo molecule generation training, use REINVENT, GuacaMol, MOSES, or transformer-based frameworks. PyTDC provides corpora and evaluation oracles.'

recommendations.title: Document error handling for invalid API parameters
recommendations.problem: Undocumented method rejection mechanism not shown
recommendations.root_cause: Warning states what not to use but not what happens if used
recommendations.fix: Add example: 'Undocumented methods may raise KeyError, ValueError, or silently fall back to defaults—verify against 1.1.15 source before use.'
